{'在英國，Ofcom要求世界盃須列為「指定體育賽事」，理論上所有世界盃賽事均須在免費地面電視直播，而兩間廣播機構BBC及ITV於飲水休息時段不播出廣告。中國國家廣電總局則規定，世界盃、亞運會及奧運會的播映權必須由央視壟斷，而央視近年均於最後一刻以較低價格從FIFA取得賽事播映權。': "In the UK, Ofcom requires the World Cup to be listed as a 'designated sporting event', meaning in theory all World Cup matches must be broadcast live on free-to-air terrestrial television, and the two broadcasters, BBC and ITV, do not run advertisements during the water-break intervals. China's National Radio and Television Administration, on the other hand, stipulates that the broadcasting rights for the World Cup, Asian Games, and Olympic Games must be monopolised by CCTV, and in recent years CCTV has obtained the broadcasting rights from FIFA at the last minute at relatively low prices."}

{'PCCW連續第三次奪得播映權，人均成本躋身全球最高之列': "PCCW Secures Broadcasting Rights for the Third Consecutive Time, with Per-Capita Cost Ranking Among the World's Highest"}

{'回到香港，持有免費電視、收費電視以及固網及流動通訊牌照的PCCW，已連續三屆取得播映權。相反，在TVB因轉播世界盃錄得虧損、有線電視結束收費電視業務後，市場上已無具備跨平台捆綁銷售優勢的競投者。': 'Back in Hong Kong, PCCW, which holds free-to-air television, pay-TV, as well as fixed-line and mobile telecommunications licences, has secured the broadcasting rights for three consecutive editions. In contrast, after TVB recorded losses from broadcasting the World Cup and Cable TV wound up its pay-TV business, there are no longer any bidders in the market with the advantage of cross-platform bundling.'}

{'FIFA據報亦藉PCCW在客戶留存方面面對的「剪線」壓力，向香港收取一定播映費。本屆世界盃的香港獨家播映權據報以一億七千萬港元售出，略低於過往幾屆，但以人均計算，香港仍位居全球最高之列。雖然今屆收看世界盃賽事的「通行證」費用未有調高，且食肆及餐廳亦加入轉播行列，加上「網上評球熱潮」為球迷提供更多選擇，但要重返昔日市民齊齊': "FIFA is also reported to have taken advantage of the 'cord-cutting' pressure PCCW faces in customer retention to charge Hong Kong a certain broadcasting fee. The exclusive Hong Kong broadcasting rights for this edition of the World Cup are reported to have been sold for HK$170 million, slightly lower than in previous editions, but on a per-capita basis, Hong Kong still ranks among the highest in the world. Although the fee for the World Cup 'pass' to watch the matches this edition has not been raised, and eateries and restaurants have also joined the rebroadcasting ranks, coupled with the 'online football commentary craze' providing fans with more options, to return to the days when citizens"}

{'商業贊助塑造遊戲規則，不止於「睇波順便睇波鞋」': "Commercial Sponsorship Shapes the Rules of the Game, Going Beyond 'Watching Football and Sneakers on the Side'"}

{'世界盃期間，從場邊廣告到VAR（影像助理裁判），每個環節均是吸引觀眾注目的黃金機會，不難理解為何商業贊助及授權亦是FIFA另一重要收入來源。FIFA將贊助商主要分為四個級別，全球贊助商每隔四年便暗中較量全球影響力。': 'During the World Cup, from pitch-side advertising to VAR (Video Assistant Referee), every element is a golden opportunity to capture the attention of spectators, making it easy to understand why commercial sponsorship and licensing are another important revenue source for FIFA. FIFA primarily categorises sponsors into four tiers, with global sponsors competing covertly for global influence every four years.'}

{'近年穩居頂級的FIFA合作夥伴均為全球知名品牌，包括Adidas、Coca-Cola、Hyundai及Visa。合作夥伴亦包括具潛力的主辦國，例如卡塔爾航空自2017年起擔任贊助商，而2034年世界盃主辦國沙地阿拉伯的油企沙特阿美，亦由本屆起加入成為贊助商，公然與FIFA交易。': "In recent years, FIFA's top-tier partners have all been globally renowned brands, including Adidas, Coca-Cola, Hyundai and Visa. Partners also include host countries with potential. For example, Qatar Airways has been a sponsor since 2017, and Saudi Aramco, the oil company of Saudi Arabia, the host country of the 2034 World Cup, has also joined as a sponsor from this edition onwards, openly transacting with FIFA."}

{'近年憑藉中文廣告標語而備受關注的中國贊助商，今屆贊助金額銳減近七成。於上兩屆擔任頂級合作夥伴的萬達，因拖欠贊助費而被除名，與同期的手機品牌Vivo一同退場。餘下的主要中國贊助商包括聯想及海信，分別為今屆新增的「裁判攝影機」及VAR顯示設備冠名贊助，以及經常以令人費解的標語「如果你': "Chinese sponsors, which have attracted attention in recent years thanks to Chinese-language advertising slogans, have seen their sponsorship amounts plummet by nearly 70 percent this edition. Wanda, which served as a top-tier partner in the previous two editions, was removed for owing sponsorship fees, exiting alongside the mobile phone brand Vivo from the same period. The remaining major Chinese sponsors include Lenovo and Hisense, which are the title sponsors of the newly added 'Referee Camera' and VAR display equipment this edition respectively, as well as frequent users of baffling slogans such as 'If you"}

{'夏蘭特代言王老吉、美斯亮相蒙牛廣告': 'Haaland Endorses Wong Lo Kat, Messi Appears in Mengniu Advertisement'}

{'賽事時差及中美關係或影響中國企業的贊助意願，但中國企業或已意識到代言的效果可能比單純的品牌曝光更具效益。例子之一，是網上熱議挪威前鋒夏蘭特的王老吉涼茶廣告。法国球星麥巴比代言東鵬飲料旗下的電解質飲品「補水啦」，該品牌今年高調在港上市，廣告特意安排於飲水休息時段播放。西班牙前鋒拉明·亞馬爾及阿根廷球王美斯': "The time difference of the matches and Sino-US relations may affect the willingness of Chinese companies to sponsor, but Chinese companies may have realised that the effect of endorsements may be more effective than mere brand exposure. One example is the widely discussed online Wong Lo Kat herbal tea advertisement featuring Norwegian forward Haaland. French star Mbappé endorses 'Bu Shui La', an electrolyte drink under Dongpeng Beverages, which made a high-profile listing in Hong Kong this year, with the advertisement deliberately scheduled to air during the water-break intervals. Spanish forward Lamine Yamal and Argentine football king Messi"}

{'世界盃贊助商的變化亦正重塑賽事的面貌。雖然美國本土品牌如美銀、電訊商Verizon，以及樂事薯片的母公司菲多利（Frito-Lay）已相繼加入，但本地主辦國的贊助往往曇花一現。至於曾是常客的日本電子企業漸從賽場上消失，外界猜測這是日本經濟衰退的訊號，事實上不少已轉投利潤率較消費電子更高的商業市場，缺乏追逐球場曝光的誘因': "The changing landscape of World Cup sponsors is also reshaping the face of the tournament. Although US domestic brands such as Bank of America, telecom carrier Verizon, and Frito-Lay (the parent company of Lay's chips) have joined one after another, sponsorships from the host country often turn out to be short-lived. As for the Japanese electronics companies that used to be regulars gradually disappearing from the pitch, outsiders speculate this is a sign of Japan's economic recession. In fact, many have shifted to commercial markets with higher profit margins than consumer electronics, lacking the incentive to chase pitch-side exposure."}

{'場館內全面禁止非贊助商品牌': 'Non-Sponsor Brands Banned Inside the Venues'}

{"在近屆世界盃中，中國贊助商在場邊集體亮相的景象，日後或不再由另一新興市場取代，反而可能逐步被潛伏於場館外的埋伏營銷所蠶食。FIFA以保障贊助商利益為由，嚴格執行「清潔球場」措施，禁止所有非贊助商品牌進入場館內。例如本屆賽事場館之一的李維斯球場（Levi's Stadium），便被暫時改名為三藩市灣區球場（San Francisco Bay Area Stadium），場內該牛仔褲品牌的巨型標誌以白布遮蓋，場內的調味料品牌標誌亦被黑色膠帶遮蓋。但聰明": "In recent editions of the World Cup, the collective appearance of Chinese sponsors pitch-side may no longer be replaced by another emerging market in the future, but rather gradually eroded by ambush marketing lurking outside the venues. Citing the protection of sponsors' interests, FIFA strictly enforces 'clean stadium' measures, prohibiting all non-sponsor brands from entering the venues. For example, Levi's Stadium, one of the venues for this edition's tournament, has been temporarily renamed San Francisco Bay Area Stadium, with the giant logo of the jeans brand inside the stadium covered by white cloth, and the condiment brand logo inside also covered by black tape.
